action_items.task: Find out more about the technology background of the advanced chip on print.
Come up with the prototype design/model.
Find out the cost of adding a display and develop the marketing strategy.

decisions.text: The remote control case will be made of wood.
The remote control will use an advanced chip on print with integrated sensor and speaker.
Stick with a simple design for now until display costs are known.
Buttons will be rubber, not wood.

notes:
## Material Selection
- Rubber was eliminated due to heat factors and compatibility issues with the board.
- Plastic was eliminated because it gets brittle and cracks over time.
- Titanium was eliminated because manufacturing cannot make curved cases out of it.
- Wood is the only remaining option, chosen for being environmentally friendly and customizable.
## Chip and Component Design
- Simple chips were rejected for lacking intelligence.
- An advanced chip on print was selected, which includes an infrared sender.
- Manufacturing will integrate a sensor and speaker into the advanced chip.
## Design Features and Layout
- Layout includes an on/off switch, volume/channel controls, menu access, and a number pad, with ergonomic molding.
- Proposed features include a flip screen to prevent accidental presses, a battery life light, audio/tactile feedback, and speech recognition.
- Customizability allows for different sizes based on hand measurements; flip screen hinge material (e.g., copper) is being considered.
- Button positioning depends on thumb placement: volume up/down, channels left/right, number pad lower due to less frequent use.
## Market Trends and Consumer Preferences
- Consumers want something 'fancy', 'feel-good', and easy to use; they are willing to pay for exciting technology.
- Current remotes are too similar and hard to use; the new design must be totally new and different.
- A flip-up display could lock the remote when closed and provide context-sensitive instructions.
## Manufacturing and Customization Ideas
- Suggestion to send a foam rubber ball with orders to mold to the user's hand shape and measure squeeze resistance for wood selection.
- Custom cases could increase revenue but require consideration of manufacturing processes and labor laws.
## Manufacturing and Cost
- Consider manufacturing in countries like India, China, or Malaysia to balance cost and features.
- Avoid exploiting labor in third-world countries; consider paying fair working wages.
- Production strategy involves business tie-ups with fabric and electronics suppliers rather than owning a factory.
## Design Concepts
- Agreement on a customisable mahogany red wooden case.
- Buttons will remain rubber for tactile experience, not wood.
- Display inclusion is undecided; currently sticking with a simple design.
## Next Steps
- UI Designer and Industrial Designer to create a prototype model.
- Marketing Expert to determine pricing for extra display options and develop marketing strategy.
tldr: The team finalized the remote control design using a wooden case and an advanced chip, agreed on a simple layout with rubber buttons, and assigned tasks for prototyping and cost analysis.
